XData.name: DTL
XData.Data:
<transform sourceClass='IHC.ITF.Response.searchQueryResponse' targetClass='IHC.ITF.Response.PersonAndPartyIdResponse' create='new' language='objectscript' >
<if condition='$IsObject(source.record.(1))' > <true> <foreach property='source.record.(1).field()' key='k1' > <if condition='source.record.(1).field.(k1).name="PTY_RLE_ID"' > <true> <assign value='source.record.(1).field.(k1).stringValue' property='target.PersonId' action='set' /> </true> </if> <if condition='source.record.(1).field.(k1).name="PTY_ID"' > <true> <assign value='source.record.(1).field.(k1).stringValue' property='target.PartyId' action='set' /> </true> </if> </foreach> </true> </if> </transform>
